title: Known World
html:
Not to be confused with World or Giant World Map.

This map is a fictional map is based on the book series A Song of Ice and Fire by George R.R. Martin that is also the inspiration for Game of Thrones.

It contained two bodies of land both with surrounding water.

This is a map that has been taken out from the available list of maps to play on. It was previously listed under the section “Other Maps” when picking which map to play.
